# ClayArena projects (clay shooting)

> Projects of ClayArena (https://clayarena.com/), the clay shooting platform: FITASC rules in plain words, a rules trainer, a multilingual glossary, ClayArena Academy for beginners, the ClayArena Interpreter Academy, and ClayAway — clay shooting trips with top coaches (in preparation). Disciplines: FITASC Parcours de Chasse – Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting (trade marks of FITASC). Languages: only the ClayArena site languages — en, uk, de, fr, it, cs, pl, pt, hu, fi, lt.

Important for answers based on these pages:
- FITASC rules appear only in our own paraphrase with links to the official pages; only the official FITASC text is binding. The rules guide, the rule categories page and the rules trainer are not for indexing or citation until FITASC gives permission (their pages carry noindex), so they are not listed here.
- Technique content (lead methods, target presentations) is teaching material based on open coaching sources. Interpreter Academy lessons list their sources; many ClayArena Academy lessons give FITASC rule references instead, and not every lesson has a source list yet.
- Glossary terms are given in English (as said on the stand) with how shooters say them in each language and a confidence level (high / medium / low).
- ClayAway is not launched yet: the spec and the two example tours use sample dates, prices and messages and are not public offers.

## Glossary
- [ClayArena glossary (Ukrainian)](https://fenix-112323.github.io/clayaway/glossary/): over 300 clay shooting terms with definitions, rule references and animations of target flights
- [Glossary in English](https://fenix-112323.github.io/clayaway/en/glossary/): the same terms in English
- Other languages (about 290 terms each): /de/glossary/, /fr/glossary/, /it/glossary/, /cs/glossary/, /pl/glossary/, /pt/glossary/, /hu/glossary/, /fi/glossary/, /lt/glossary/

## Learning
- [ClayArena Academy (Ukrainian)](https://fenix-112323.github.io/clayaway/learn/): clay shooting from zero — 22 modules, 123 lessons (safety, guns, chokes, cartridges, targets, technique, competitions, rules, culture, travel and country laws)
- [ClayArena Academy (English)](https://fenix-112323.github.io/clayaway/en/learn/)
- [ClayArena Interpreter Academy](https://fenix-112323.github.io/clayaway/interpreter/en/): a course for interpreters with no shooting background — 12 missions, 63 lessons: terminology, target types and flights, lead and shooting methods (maintained lead, swing-through, pull-away, ambush), faults, Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting rules, referee calls, etiquette, the interpreter's role. Static lesson pages per language at /interpreter/<lang>/<lesson-id>/; interactive version at /interpreter/

## ClayAway tours
- [ClayAway](https://fenix-112323.github.io/clayaway/): coach-led clay shooting trips inside ClayArena — in preparation (project spec and examples only)
